item.title: DOJ proposes changes to immigration appeals process to dismiss backlog of cases
item.description: The Department of Justice has proposed a new regulation to the Board of Immigration Appeals process that would limit immigrants' options to fight deportation orders, reducing the appeal deadline from 30 days to 10 days and making summary dismissal the default judgment.

item.title: Proposed California bill aims to protect concertgoers from skyrocketing resale tickets
item.description: California Assemblymember Matt Haney has introduced a bill to cap ticket resale prices at 10% above face value, targeting large-scale ticket brokers, automated bots and resale platforms that drive prices far beyond what artists and venues originally intended.

item.title: Construction worker injured in local work zone prompts police to ramp up speeding enforcement
item.description: San Diego police and public works officials are increasing enforcement and education efforts in construction zones after a worker was seriously injured in a crash caused by a driver failing to slow down.

item.title: Fifteen arrested in crackdown on illegal activity along Sprinter rail line
item.description: Fifteen people were arrested during a joint law enforcement operation targeting illegal activity along the SPRINTER train right-of-way in North County, led by the Sheriff's Transit Enforcement Unit, the Vista Patrol Station's Gang Enforcement Team and the Oceanside Police Department.

item.title: Rep. Juan Vargas denied access to Otay Mesa Detention Center for oversight visit
item.description: Rep. Juan Vargas said he is considering legal action after being denied access Friday to the Otay Mesa Detention Center, raising concerns about conditions for immigration detainees.

item.title: San Diego announces free Balboa Park parking zones for city residents
item.description: In the latest development regarding paid parking in Balboa Park, San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria announced on Friday he will expand free parking zones for residents.

item.title: Spring Valley search warrant yields guns and stolen property, including Home Depot truck
item.description: A 34-year-old man in Spring Valley, California was arrested on suspicion of drug, weapon, and fraud charges after a high-risk search warrant of his home yielded firearms, narcotics, stolen property, and a fraud lab.

item.title: Pedestrian fatally struck by minivan in San Marcos crash
item.description: A pedestrian was struck and killed by a minivan on West Mission Road in San Marcos on Friday evening, and the driver stayed at the scene to cooperate with investigators.

item.title: Police investigate threatening calls at San Diego, Garfield high schools
item.description: San Diego High School, Helix High School, and Garfield High School received threatening phone calls prompting a police response, with no threat found at San Diego High School and the investigation still ongoing.

item.title: Authorities investigating threat at Helix Charter High School
item.description: Authorities responded to reports of a threat at Helix Charter High School in La Mesa on Friday.
